relevance_note: The cohort paper describes one identifiable child with an HA20-related diagnosis and a TNFAIP3 mutation: "One patient with Familial Behçet-Like Autoinflammatory Syndrome caused by a TNFAIP3 mutation received infliximab treatment".
method_note: Cohort study of 80 children with unexplained liver disease (65 in Group A, 15 in Group B); only one child carries a TNFAIP3 mutation ("1 TNFAIP3" among the 19 gene mutations) and is the sole in-scope person. That child has no label in the paper, so the label rule 6 label "unnamed person 1" was used; no relatives of this child are described. Variant details are not printed anywhere in this file ("Detailed information on all variants is provided in Supplementary Table 1."); the converted file contains no Supplementary material section, so the variants row keeps variant_original_string = "not reported" (v3 rule). Variant-level fields (type, zygosity, inheritance, pathogenicity, ACMG, functional evidence) were left "not reported": the paper's variant classes and the P/LP counts are cohort-level statements ("A total of 53 P/LP variants were identified in 42 patients", "The reported variants included 17 missense variants, 5 splicing variants...") that do not name this person or a named group containing them. Sex, age, ancestry, vital status per person and family history are not given for this child. Group statements used only where they name a group that includes this child: "No consanguineous marriages were found in the cohort." and "All patients survived during the follow-up". Table 1 and Table 2 of this paper are group-level/reference tables with no patients as rows or columns, so no stacked-cell (" / ") issue arose; no contradictions were found. All spans were copied verbatim from the Markdown file by hand (no script transcribed any table).
